subject: general
question: A path 6 m wide runs around and outside of a rectangular plot of length 10 m and breadth 8 m. The area (in m²) of the path is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **path outside** a rectangle, **Area of path** = 2w(L + B + 2w)

Given: **Length (L)** = 10 m, **Breadth (B)** = 8 m, **Width (w)** = 6 m

⇒ Area = 2 × 6 × (10 + 8 + 2 × 6)

⇒ Area = 12 × (18 + 12) = 12 × 30 = 360 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 360 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Inner Length** = 10 m, **Inner Breadth** = 8 m

**Path Width** = 6 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eb0cf74e3a4092343c2e821e35c426a8a5f77aae4d24ee33aaea2239e00c14a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Inner Area** = Length × Breadth = 10 × 8 = 80 m²

⇒ **Outer Length** = 10 + (2 × 6) = 22 m

⇒ **Outer Breadth** = 8 + (2 × 6) = 20 m

⇒ **Outer Area** = 22 × 20 = 440 m²

⇒ **Area of Path** = Outer Area − Inner Area

⇒ **Area of Path** = 440 − 80 = 360 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 360 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Path Inside Rectangle

If the path is built inside the rectangle, the area of the path is given by 2w(L + B − 2w).

Middle Cross Paths

For two paths of width w crossing each other at right angles in the center: Area = w(L + B − w).

Cost of Graveling/Paving

Total Cost = Area of the path × Rate per unit area.</p
